data.name: TenantAuditRetInfo
data.value: How many days audit-log events are kept before the background worker purges them. 0 = keep forever. The tamper-evident hash chain stays verifiable across a purge.

data.name: TenantCoTtlInfo
data.value: Automatically releases a check-out left idle this many days: the lock is cleared, any un-checked-in cloud working copy is discarded, and the holder is notified. 0 = never expire.

data.name: TenantCoWarnInfo
data.value: Warns the holder this many days before an idle check-out is auto-released, so they can check in or keep working. 0 = no warning. Only applies when auto-release is enabled.

data.name: TenantWormInfo
data.value: How immutable retention/legal-hold-locked document versions are in object storage. Governance: an admin with the bypass permission can shorten or remove a lock. Compliance: absolute — no one, not even an administrator, can delete a version before its retention expires.

data.name: TenantQuotaInfo
data.value: Maximum total storage for this tenant's document content, in megabytes. An upload that would exceed it is rejected. Leave blank for no limit.

data.name: TenantRecomputeInfo
data.value: Recomputes used-storage from the actual stored files. Use it if the figure looks wrong — e.g. after importing, or for content that predates storage accounting.

data.name: TenantUploadCleanupInfo
data.value: A per-tenant object-storage bucket policy: abandoned multipart uploads are aborted after this many days. 0 = off. This app uploads in a single request (not multipart), so it has no effect today — it's a bucket-policy control whose effect runs on a lifecycle-capable backend (e.g. AWS S3).

data.name: TenantRequireMfaInfo
data.value: When on, every user in this tenant must have two-factor authentication (TOTP) enrolled to sign in — the login page walks a not-yet-enrolled user through setup before granting access.

data.name: TenantAllowPasskeyInfo
data.value: When on, a user in this tenant who has registered a passkey can sign in with it alone — no password. A passkey with user verification is phishing-resistant multi-factor, so it also satisfies the require-two-factor policy above.

data.name: TenantRequireDispositionInfo
data.value: When on, the retention sweep does NOT auto-delete expired documents. Instead they wait in the Retention tab as a review queue for a records manager to Dispose or Extend each one — a defensible, reviewed disposition. When off, expired un-held records are auto-disposed to the recycle bin.

data.name: TenantRestrictTagsInfo
data.value: When on, a document can only be given tags that already exist in the tag catalog (managed on the Tags tab) — a controlled vocabulary. When off, any tag can be typed freely and is added to the catalog automatically.

data.name: TenantEnforceClearanceInfo
data.value: When on, a user can only see or open a document whose sensitivity label ranks at or below their clearance (set per user/group in the Users & groups tab). Documents above their clearance are hidden from listings and search entirely. Tenant admins bypass this. When off, sensitivity labels are informational only. New users start at clearance 0, so grant clearances before turning this on.

data.name: TenantWebhookUrlInfo
data.value: Each audit event is POSTed as JSON to this absolute http(s) URL shortly after it is recorded, in order, with an X-SimplArchive-Signature: sha256=<hmac> header so the receiver can verify authenticity and integrity. Leave blank to disable streaming.

data.name: TenantSecretLabelKeep
data.value: Signing secret (leave blank to keep the current one)

data.name: TenantSecretInfo
data.value: The HMAC-SHA256 key used to sign each delivered event. Stored encrypted at rest and never shown again after saving. Required the first time you enable a webhook; leave blank on later edits to keep the existing secret.

data.name: TenantDeliveryInfo
data.value: How the SIEM webhook is delivering. On failures the server retries with exponential backoff (up to ~hourly) and self-heals when the endpoint recovers; a success resets the count. No events are dropped — undelivered events are held at the checkpoint.
